hints.content: Therefore, we can set up equivalent proportions and solve for $p$.

$\dfrac{\red{p}}{\blue{24}} = \dfrac{\red{22.5}}{\blue{18}}$

 Note: As each corresponding $\dfrac{\red{\text{side}}}{\blue{\text{side}}}$ proportion is equivalent, you could use the other sides (i.e., $\dfrac{\red{p}}{\blue{24}} = \dfrac{\red{20}}{\blue{16}}$)

Reduce the proportion on the right hand side.

 $\dfrac{\red{p}}{\blue{24}} = \cancel{\dfrac{\red{22.5}}{\blue{18}}}{\green{\dfrac{5}{4}}}$

Multiply each side by $24$ and simplify.

 $\cancel{24} \times \dfrac{\red{p}}{\cancel{\blue{24}}} = \green{\dfrac{5}{4}} \times 24$
